## Radar signals

Checks the watchlist every two hours and scores anything new against the signal rubric. Dry run by default. Payloads land in test/last_signal.txt on the host and nothing is sent.

Arming steps.
1. Set repo_path and python_bin in the Config node if the defaults are wrong.
2. Spot-check two sources from the host, e.g. `python3 scripts/check_signals.py --dry-run --source qbic`
3. Send one manual test push to the ntfy topic so you know it reaches your phone.
4. Edit the Check signals node and change `--dry-run` to `--push`.
5. Activate the workflow.

Politeness lives in the script, not here. Robots.txt respected, one request per source per check, six-hour floor between checks, etag and last-modified honoured. Re-runs never duplicate or re-score, so a manual execution is always safe.
